items.html:
Casting: Supporting Actress for Mumbai Web Series

Blue Lantern Pictures is casting a supporting role for an eight-episode Hindi web series.

  • Role: supporting actress, age 22-30, female
  • Languages: Hindi, English
  • Location: Mumbai
  • Shoot: 12 January 2027 to 20 January 2027
  • Pay: Rs 15,000 per day
  • Audition: self tape, then an in-person callback
  • Deadline: 15 December 2026

Send your self tape and showreel to casting@bluelantern.example. No nudity required. Travel within Mumbai is covered.

items.title: Five ways to improve your acting showreel
items.text:
Five ways to improve your acting showreel.

A showreel is a short compilation of your best on-screen work. Keep it under two minutes, lead with your strongest scene, and make sure the sound is clean. This article is general advice for performers, not a job posting.
